title: SEKTION high cabinet/pull-out int fittings
description: SEKTION high cabinet/pull-out int fittings, white/Voxtorp matte white, 18x24x90" SEKTION kitchen system gives you endless possibilities to design your dream kitchen. Paired with VOXTORP fronts in matte white with integrated handles, you get a modern and minimalist expression.
features: To be completed with SEKTION suspension rail for mounting the cabinet to the wall.
Different wall materials require different types of fasteners. Use fasteners suitable for the walls in your home.
The hinge is adjustable in height, depth and width.
To be finished with legs and plinth, sold separately.
materialAndCare: Front: Particleboard; Front side: Plastic foil (min. 80% recycled); Back side: Plastic foil; Edge: Plastic edging; Frame: Particleboard, Melamine foil, Plastic edging; Back: Fiberboard, Acrylic paint; Main parts: Steel, Pigmented epoxy/polyester powder coating; Plastic parts: Polypropylene; Particleboard, Melamine foil, Plastic edging; Steel, Nickel plated
